description: Manage Jenkins builds with Jenkins REST API.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: A list of parameters to pass to the build.

parameters.name: build_number
parameters.description: An integer which specifies a build of a job. Is required to remove a build from the queue.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: Enable detached mode to not wait for the build end. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the Jenkins job to build.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Attribute that specifies if the build is to be created, deleted or stopped. The stopped state has been added in community.general 3.3.0. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "stopped"

parameters.name: time_between_checks
parameters.description: Time in seconds to wait between requests to the Jenkins server. This times must be higher than the configured quiet time for the job. Default: 10

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: API token used to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the Jenkins server. Default: "http://localhost:8080"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User to authenticate with the Jenkins server.

examples:
- name: Create a jenkins build using basic authentication
  community.general.jenkins_build:
    name: "test-check"
    args:
      cloud: "test"
      availability_zone: "test_az"
    state: present
    user: admin
    password: asdfg
    url: http://localhost:8080

- name: Stop a running jenkins build anonymously
  community.general.jenkins_build:
    name: "stop-check"
    build_number: 3
    state: stopped
    url: http://localhost:8080

- name: Trigger Jenkins build in detached mode
  community.general.jenkins_build:
    name: "detached-build"
    state: present
    user: admin
    token: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456
    url: http://localhost:8080
    detach: true
    time_between_checks: 20

- name: Delete a jenkins build using token authentication
  community.general.jenkins_build:
    name: "delete-experiment"
    build_number: 30
    state: absent
    user: Jenkins
    token: abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456
    url: http://localhost:8080

return_values.name: build_info
return_values.description: Build info of the jenkins job. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the jenkins job. Returned: success Sample: "test-job"

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: State of the jenkins job. Returned: success Sample: "present"

return_values.name: url
return_values.description: URL to connect to the Jenkins server. Returned: success Sample: "https://jenkins.mydomain.com"

return_values.name: user
return_values.description: User used for authentication. Returned: success Sample: "admin"
